review.notes: All 7 physical pages' extracted text swept line-by-line against the OCR markdown (normalized): all prose matches, no code fences, heading structure matches the printed sections. Three footnote bodies that print under the footnote rule (physical p.4 and p.6) are missing from the OCR markdown while the inline markers $^{1}$/$^{2}$/$^{3}$ survive; each body was transcribed and visually confirmed on 150-dpi renders of the page bottoms. The Acknowledgements contributor list is present. The TOC dot leaders and the escaped metric names (not\_unsafe, not\_overrefuse) render as printed and are not defects.
